section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section focuses on the factor structure and psychometric properties of a Romanian translation of the BAS-2. The present study found a one-dimensional factor structure for the BAS-2 in a student sample, but noted a lack of configural and intercept invariance across women and men. The study also reported that BAS-2 scores were significantly and negatively correlated with BMI, and provided evidence for the internal consistency and test-retest reliability of the measure in Romanian-speaking populations.
